Correct conversion remains slower for some coefficients/scales than the earlier formula, which double-rounds some values. The text-parsing fallback is particularly expensive. No zero-overhead or complete-performance-resolution claim is made.

Kernel before timings execute the original formula in the candidate benchmark binary; they are not timings of a separately built unmodified Arrow crate. The SQL measurements use separate saved before/after executables.

Measurements cover one host and compiler, fixed in-memory batches and a small set of queries. Delta I/O, concurrency and deployment workloads are unmeasured; earlier unattributed buffer-policy timing differences remain unaudited here.
